human_review_text: The paper proposes a new method for knowledge distillation: instead of the student trying to mimic the direct output of the teacher, it mimics the difference between two samples (the student's difference should match the teacher's difference). The authors claim that their method is better suited in resource constrained situations where one can only get teacher's outputs a few times. They compare their proposed method (CKD) to different baselines and show improved results on CIFAR100 dataset.
